podcasts.title: 6 Minute English
podcasts.author: BBC Radio
podcasts.summary_zh: 每期 6 分钟聊一个日常或科技话题，语速适中，结尾精讲 6 个高频词汇。
podcasts.summary_en: 6-minute topical discussions in clear British English with six key vocabulary explanations.

podcasts.title: Learning English Conversations
podcasts.author: BBC Radio
podcasts.summary_zh: 3 分钟短节目（原 The English We Speak），聚焦地道英语俚语与高频表达。
podcasts.summary_en: 3-minute bite-sized episodes unpacking everyday British idioms and spoken phrases.

podcasts.title: Learning English Vocabulary
podcasts.author: BBC Radio
podcasts.summary_zh: 6 分钟词汇精讲，围绕词根、搭配与易混用法展开，入门零压力。
podcasts.summary_en: 6-minute accessible lessons on practical vocabulary, prefixes, and collocations.

podcasts.title: Learning English from the News
podcasts.author: BBC Radio
podcasts.summary_zh: 用 8 分钟拆解本周全球热点新闻标题和原声片段，是过渡到外刊新闻的阶梯。
podcasts.summary_en: 8-minute breakdowns of global news headlines and real broadcast clips for learners.

podcasts.title: Espresso English Podcast
podcasts.author: Shayna Oliveira
podcasts.summary_zh: 每期 2–5 分钟超短美式英语微课，发音清晰缓慢，适合碎片时间精听。
podcasts.summary_en: Short, clear American English mini-lessons on grammar, idioms, and everyday usage.

podcasts.title: The Indicator from Planet Money
podcasts.author: NPR
podcasts.summary_zh: NPR 出品的 9 分钟经济商业短评，每天一个数字讲清商业与生活现象。
podcasts.summary_en: Daily 9-minute economics and business insights explained through one key number.

podcasts.title: Up First from NPR
podcasts.author: NPR
podcasts.summary_zh: 每天早晨 13 分钟速览三条国际要闻，播报干练、信息密度高。
podcasts.summary_en: Crisp 13-minute morning briefing covering the top three global and US news stories.

podcasts.title: Short Wave
podcasts.author: NPR
podcasts.summary_zh: NPR 每日 14 分钟趣味科普，把前沿科学发现讲得轻松好懂。
podcasts.summary_en: Lively 14-minute science episodes unpacking everyday mysteries and new discoveries.

podcasts.title: Plain English
podcasts.author: Jeff at Plain English
podcasts.summary_zh: 专为中级学习者放慢语速的时事与生活播客，每期附带一个核心短语拆解。
podcasts.summary_en: Current events and culture delivered at a learner-friendly pace with one key expression per episode.

podcasts.title: Science Quickly
podcasts.author: Scientific American
podcasts.summary_zh: 《科学美国人》短篇科普电台，15 分钟内聚焦医学、天文与气候热点。
podcasts.summary_en: Concise science reporting from Scientific American on health, tech, space, and nature.

podcasts.title: TED Talks Daily
podcasts.author: TED
podcasts.summary_zh: 每日一期 TED 演讲音频，覆盖多国口音与多元主题，适合练演讲与论证表达。
podcasts.summary_en: Daily TED Talks spanning technology, psychology, and culture across global accents.

podcasts.title: All Ears English Podcast
podcasts.author: Lindsay McMahon and Michelle Kaplan
podcasts.summary_zh: 两位美国主播对谈地道日常口语、社交寒暄与文化礼仪，轻松自然、更新极勤。
podcasts.summary_en: Natural American English conversations on idioms, workplace chat, and cultural nuances.

podcasts.title: Learn English Through Listening
podcasts.author: Hilary Platt
podcasts.summary_zh: 温和清晰的英式慢速听力课，围绕日常话题反复输入实用句型，对新手极友好。
podcasts.summary_en: Gentle, clear British English listening practice designed to build confidence through repetition.

podcasts.title: Thinking in English
podcasts.author: Thomas Wilkinson
podcasts.summary_zh: 用清晰英音探讨国际时事、文化与思维方式，帮你从“背单词”转向“用英语思考”。
podcasts.summary_en: Thoughtful British English episodes on world affairs and ideas tailored for intermediate learners.

podcasts.title: English Learning for Curious Minds
podcasts.author: Leonardo English
podcasts.summary_zh: 用迷人的历史、人物与社会故事学英式英语，语速略慢于母语播客、内容很有质感。
podcasts.summary_en: Engaging stories from history, culture, and science spoken in crisp, well-paced British English.

podcasts.title: Culips Everyday English Podcast
podcasts.author: Culips English Podcast
podcasts.summary_zh: 北美真实口语聊天节目，穿插 Simplified Speech 与惯用语讲解，贴近真实交流节奏。
podcasts.summary_en: Natural North American conversations paired with practical idiom and spoken-English breakdowns.

podcasts.title: RealLife English Podcast
podcasts.author: RealLife English
podcasts.summary_zh: 拆解影视剧对白、流行文化与真实对话中的连读和口语习惯，适合练流利度。
podcasts.summary_en: Conversational episodes breaking down movies, connected speech, and real-world fluency habits.

podcasts.title: Aussie English
podcasts.author: Pete Smissen
podcasts.summary_zh: 自带官方逐字稿的澳式英语宝藏电台，涵盖澳洲俚语、发音技巧与深度访谈。
podcasts.summary_en: Australian English slang, pronunciation tips, and interviews with official Podcast 2.0 transcripts.

podcasts.title: Luke's ENGLISH Podcast
podcasts.author: Luke Thompson
podcasts.summary_zh: 伦敦脱口秀演员兼英语教师主讲，幽默耐听，兼具纯正英音和大量生活表达。
podcasts.summary_en: Humorous, long-form British English episodes by a teacher and stand-up comedian.

podcasts.title: Practical AI
podcasts.author: Daniel Whitenack & Chris Benson
podcasts.summary_zh: 自带官方字幕的 AI 工程落地播客，紧跟大模型、开源推理与实际应用场景。
podcasts.summary_en: Accessible conversations on real-world LLMs, ML engineering, and AI tooling with transcripts.

podcasts.title: The Changelog
podcasts.author: Changelog Media
podcasts.summary_zh: 老牌开源与软件工程深度访谈，覆盖系统架构、开源生态与一线开发者故事。
podcasts.summary_en: In-depth interviews with open-source maintainers and software engineers.

podcasts.title: Darknet Diaries
podcasts.author: Jack Rhysider
podcasts.summary_zh: 自带官方字幕的真实网络安全故事，叙事节奏像悬疑片，边追故事边磨耳朵。
podcasts.summary_en: Gripping true stories from the dark side of the internet and cybersecurity, with transcripts.

podcasts.title: Latent Space: The AI Engineer Podcast
podcasts.author: Latent.Space
podcasts.summary_zh: 一线 AI 工程师深度访谈，覆盖 Agent、模型训练与基础设施，附官方字幕。
podcasts.summary_en: Technical deep dives with AI researchers and founders on agents, models, and infra, with transcripts.

podcasts.title: Dwarkesh Podcast
podcasts.author: Dwarkesh Patel
podcasts.summary_zh: 高密度长访谈，对话顶级 AI 科学家、历史学家与创始人，提供官方字幕。
podcasts.summary_en: Researched long-form interviews with AI pioneers, scientists, and historians, with transcripts.

podcasts.title: Hard Fork
podcasts.author: The New York Times
podcasts.summary_zh: 《纽约时报》两位科技记者每周轻松复盘硅谷与 AI 热点，幽默又不失深度。
podcasts.summary_en: Weekly NYT tech and AI commentary balancing sharp reporting with witty banter.

podcasts.title: Syntax - Tasty Web Development Treats
podcasts.author: Wes Bos & Scott Tolinski
podcasts.summary_zh: 全栈与前端开发热门双人电台，聊 TypeScript、浏览器新特性与开发效率。
podcasts.summary_en: Lively full-stack web development discussions covering JavaScript, CSS, and modern tooling.

podcasts.title: CoRecursive: Coding Stories
podcasts.author: Adam Gordon Bell
podcasts.summary_zh: 讲述程序员与经典软件背后的真实人物故事，剪辑精良、情感真挚。
podcasts.summary_en: Narrative-driven stories about the people behind influential software and engineering breakthroughs.

podcasts.title: ShopTalk
podcasts.author: Chris Coyier & Dave Rupert
podcasts.summary_zh: 经典前端设计与 Web 开发对谈节目，氛围松弛，适合熟悉欧美工程师日常口语。
podcasts.summary_en: Long-running web design and front-end development talk show with candid developer banter.

podcasts.title: Acquired
podcasts.author: Ben Gilbert & David Rosenthal
podcasts.summary_zh: 深度复盘伟大科技与消费公司的完整发展史，自带官方字幕，适合分段精听。
podcasts.summary_en: Exhaustively researched company histories of iconic tech and business giants, with transcripts.

podcasts.title: WSJ What’s News
podcasts.author: The Wall Street Journal
podcasts.summary_zh: 《华尔街日报》每日 14 分钟财经与商业快讯，用词地道紧凑。
podcasts.summary_en: Twice-daily 14-minute business, market, and global headlines from The Wall Street Journal.

podcasts.title: The Intelligence from The Economist
podcasts.author: The Economist
podcasts.summary_zh: 《经济学人》王牌日更，纯正英音与高水准书面化表达，精听冲刺高阶首选。
podcasts.summary_en: Daily global reporting and analysis from The Economist's correspondents in polished British English.

podcasts.title: Planet Money
podcasts.author: NPR
podcasts.summary_zh: 用好听的故事讲透经济学与商业机制，叙事生动、语言鲜活。
podcasts.summary_en: Story-driven explanations of how the economy works, told with humor and clarity.

podcasts.title: Marketplace
podcasts.author: Marketplace
podcasts.summary_zh: 工作日日更商业经济广播，聚焦普通人视角的市场动态与行业趋势。
podcasts.summary_en: Weekday business and economy coverage connecting Wall Street shifts to everyday life.

podcasts.title: Global News Podcast
podcasts.author: BBC World Service
podcasts.summary_zh: BBC 国际新闻每日两更，覆盖世界各地记者连线，是练新闻听力与多国口音的标杆。
podcasts.summary_en: Twice-daily international news digest from BBC World Service correspondents worldwide.

podcasts.title: The Daily
podcasts.author: The New York Times
podcasts.summary_zh: 《纽约时报》现象级日更深度新闻，每期用 30 分钟透彻梳理一件全球大事。
podcasts.summary_en: Flagship NYT news podcast diving deep into one major story each weekday.

podcasts.title: Freakonomics Radio
podcasts.author: Freakonomics Radio
podcasts.summary_zh: 《魔鬼经济学》衍生电台，用反常识视角与数据拆解社会、心理与商业现象。
podcasts.summary_en: Counterintuitive investigations into economics, human behavior, and hidden incentives.

podcasts.title: Stuff You Should Know
podcasts.author: iHeartPodcasts
podcasts.summary_zh: 自带官方字幕的百科漫谈常青树，两位主持用轻松美式对话科普万物原理。
podcasts.summary_en: Relaxed, curious deep dives into how almost everything works, complete with official transcripts.

podcasts.title: 99% Invisible
podcasts.author: Roman Mars
podcasts.summary_zh: 发掘城市、建筑与日常物品背后被忽略的设计巧思，声线磁性清晰、极耐听。
podcasts.summary_en: Crafted stories about the unnoticed architecture and design shaping our everyday world.

podcasts.title: Radiolab
podcasts.author: WNYC Studios
podcasts.summary_zh: 以电影级音效闻名的科学调查电台，把生物学、物理与人性故事拍成声音纪录片。
podcasts.summary_en: Sound-rich investigative journalism exploring science, philosophy, and human curiosity.

podcasts.title: Science Vs
podcasts.author: Spotify Studios
podcasts.summary_zh: 用论文和实验核查流行养生与社会传言，澳音主持风趣活泼、节奏明快。
podcasts.summary_en: Fact-checking fads and popular myths against scientific research with lively Australian narration.

podcasts.title: The Infinite Monkey Cage
podcasts.author: BBC Radio 4
podcasts.summary_zh: BBC Radio 4 科学脱口秀，物理学家 Brian Cox 与喜剧人碰撞出满场英式幽默。
podcasts.summary_en: Witty BBC Radio 4 panel show mixing scientists and comedians on big scientific questions.

podcasts.title: Hidden Brain
podcasts.author: Hidden Brain
podcasts.summary_zh: 探索左右决策、情绪与人际关系的心理学机制，吐字沉稳清晰、极具启发。
podcasts.summary_en: Clear, insightful explorations of the unconscious patterns driving human behavior and choices.

podcasts.title: This American Life
podcasts.author: This American Life
podcasts.summary_zh: 普利策奖级非虚构叙事电台，每周围绕一个主题讲述数个真实而动人的故事。
podcasts.summary_en: Acclaimed weekly journalism and storytelling themed around unforgettable true stories.

podcasts.title: The Rest Is History
podcasts.author: Goalhanger
podcasts.summary_zh: 英国最受欢迎的历史对谈播客，两位历史学家妙语连珠，带你身临其境看世界史。
podcasts.summary_en: Witty, vivid British historians unpacking turning points in world history.

podcasts.title: Ologies with Alie Ward
podcasts.author: Alie Ward
podcasts.summary_zh: 每期请一位冷门学科专家回答脑洞大开的问题，充满好奇心与鲜活口语。
podcasts.summary_en: Enthusiastic interviews asking quirky, thoughtful questions to experts in every '-ology'.
